queue.title: 伯特利EPB再获欧洲项目定点，电控制动产品加速走向全球
queue.text:
近日，伯特利再度与全球某头部车企达成合作，将为其两个欧洲项目开发供货电子驻车制动卡钳(EPB)。近年来，伯特利海外项目持续落地，产品布局不断升级，已从传统机械产品拓展至电子电控产品，技术创新已成为公司加速出海的核心底气。

历经长期投入和持续迭代，伯特利电子驻车制动卡钳产品已经建立起完善的研发与量产体系。围绕产品性能、可靠性以及不同车型平台的适配需求，公司持续推进技术优化，在机械设计、执行机构、控制策略和系统集成等关键环节积累了丰富经验，并具备从研发验证到规模化交付的完整能力。 截至今年上半年，伯特利电子驻车制动卡钳累计供货量约3845万件，市场份额在中国品牌供应商中持续第一。

早在2022年，伯特利电子驻车制动卡钳获得海外车企项目定点，成为国内首批进入海外头部市场的电控制动产品Tier 1供应商；该项目已于2024年成功量产并实现稳定供货。2025年，伯特利面向欧洲市场正式设立德国法兰克福研发中心，承担欧洲市场协同的重要职能。围绕客户需求、技术交流及项目推进开展工作，加强海外客户与国内研发团队之间的沟通衔接。同年11月，摩洛哥生产基地完成土地签约。目前，该基地已完成厂房规划，未来将投产相关制动产品，为欧洲市场提供有力支撑。欧洲不仅是公司全球化战略中的关键市场，更将成为公司推动创新、提升核心竞争力、实现可持续发展的战略要地。

从产品进入海外市场，到研发、服务与交付能力同步走向全球，伯特利的国际化布局正不断深入。面向未来，伯特利将继续推进产品技术创新与全球化布局，持续提升研发、制造和服务能力，推动公司业务在全球市场持续拓展。

queue.title: 创新夯实长期价值｜伯特利蝉联中国证券报金牛奖
queue.text:
近日，由中国证券报主办的2026年上市公司金牛奖榜单正式揭晓， 伯特利（证券代码：603596）再度荣获上市公司金牛 最具投资价值奖、金牛董秘奖 ，充分彰显了公司在汽车智能化浪潮中的成长韧性与投资价值。

金牛奖长期关注上市公司的科技创新与高质量发展，是中国资本市场最具公信力和影响力的权威奖项之一。此次获奖，既是对伯特利持续投入技术研发、推动创新成果落地的认可，也是对公司规范治理与长期价值导向的肯定。公司严守规范治理要求，坚持信息披露透明，切实维护全体投资者合法权益，将长期主义贯穿企业经营全过程。

伯特利深耕汽车核心零部件领域，围绕制动、转向、悬架、智驾持续进行技术积累，不断拓展技术和产品边界。从传统制动产品升级，到智能电控、前沿线控等新方向，推动技术成果转化为面向市场的产品和解决方案。EMB是公司在线控制动领域的最新成果。2026年3月，伯特利EMB完成首个项目量产，成为全球首家实现全干式EMB技术突破及量产的供应商，不仅丰富了线控制动产品布局，也体现出公司将前沿技术转化为工程化、规模化产品的能力。 2026年上半年，伯特利实现营业收入62.72亿元，同比增长21.46%。

产业布局与资本运作同步推进。伯特利成功发行28亿元可转换公司债券，为核心产能建设提供资金保障，提前布局EMB、电控悬架及机器人核心零部件等新业务产线建设与产能储备。同时，公司推进摩洛哥海外建厂、设立机器人产业基金、合资电机公司等布局，并完成对豫北转向的收购，进一步增强电控转向能力，与制动、悬架业务形成协同。目前，公司正筹划发行H股并在香港联交所主板上市，拓宽国际融资渠道、支撑海外产能扩张、提升国际品牌影响力。

从制动到XYZ智能底盘，再到机器人等新兴应用场景，伯特利持续围绕核心技术和产业需求推进研发与创新。未来，伯特利将以稳健经营和持续价值，不断回报投资者信任，推动经营效益与股东价值协同提升。

queue.title: 伯特利入选工信部首批国家新兴产业发展示范名单
queue.text:
近日，国家工业和信息化部公示首批国家新兴产业发展示范基地创建对象初步名单。在“智能网联新能源汽车”领域，全国共遴选出17家企业， 安徽省内奇瑞汽车与伯特利荣耀上榜。 伯特利在汽车智能底盘系统领域的深厚积累、全栈自研能力和产业化成果，再次跻身国家级示范企业行列。

近年来，中国汽车产销和出口持续位居全球第一，高速发展的产业生态为技术创新提供了丰沃的土壤。伯特利先后推出了中国品牌首款ONE-BOX线控制动系统、全球首款量产全干式EMB、全球独创的线控制动融合电控减振器方案等产品。这些产品将智能驾驶的决策指令转化为稳定、高效、敏捷的底盘运动与控制响应，对保障驾乘安全性、舒适性至关重要。公司先后获评 国家知识产权示范企业、国家专精特新“小巨人”企业、国家火炬计划重点高新技术企业、中国汽车工程学会科学技术奖创新团队，并参与多项国家级及省部级重点科研项目， 持续推动汽车智能底盘系统领域技术突破。

创新是伯特利发展的核心驱动力。公司已构建芜湖总部研发平台为核心，上海、新乡、合肥、西安等多地研发中心协同联动，底特律、法兰克福等海外研发中心全球布局，专注于汽车智能底盘系统，构建制动系统（X轴）、转向系统（Y轴）、悬架系统（Z轴）到智能驾驶系统的核心技术自研体系， 成为全球汽车零部件行业中少数能够提供底盘XYZ全系解决方案并实现系统级整合的供应商之一。

此次入选工信部首批国家新兴产业发展示范基地创建对象初步名单，既是对伯特利在智能网联新能源汽车产业链贡献的肯定，更是对公司未来发展的鞭策。伯特利将继续以创新为驱动，围绕XYZ三轴协同与智能驾驶需求，将已验证的技术成果转化为更大规模的交付。勇担时代使命，助力中国智能汽车产业持续高质量发展。

queue.title: 伯特利EPB卡钳累计量产突破4000万件，从“中国首位”迈向“全...
queue.text:
2026年9月17日，伯特利电子驻车制动卡钳（EPB）累计量产数正式突破4000万件，成为中国零部件企业中首家达到这一量产规模的企业。放眼全球汽车零部件行业，同类产品达到这一规模的企业屈指可数，伯特利已跻身全球第一梯队。

创新，是流淌在伯特利血脉里的DNA。2012年，伯特利首个EPB项目实现量产，成为全球第二家、中国品牌首家量产该产品的企业。自主研发的集成式EPB拥有独立自主知识产权，打破了国际公司的独家供应局面，显著降低了国产汽车零部件成本。

量产之后，产品不断升级。从独立式EPB、集成式EPBi，到双控EPB、前置EPB、WCBS备份EPB。围绕不同车型平台的空间布置、制动性能和可靠性需求，伯特利持续优化机械设计、执行机构、控制策略及系统集成，逐步形成覆盖不同应用需求的EPB产品体系。产品一次次迭代，项目数量也在不断增加。2020年，第100个EPB项目实现量产；2024年，第300个项目量产；如今，累计量产项目超500个。

仪式现场，伯特利董事长袁永彬博士表示，这一节点背后，是十余年研发、迭代和量产实践的积累。对于参与项目的相关人员，他给予肯定和表扬，并希望大家继续把产品做好、把项目做好，在后续开发和量产交付中保持这份投入和协同。

每一个量产项目最终都要落到生产线上，成为一件件真正交付到客户手中的产品。经过十余年量产实践，伯特利卡钳装配线历经三次迭代升级，已发展为国内领先的自动化线。装配线采用双环形线设计，自动化率达到90%以上。产品关键性能如低压密封性、高压密封性、真空密封性、夹紧力、总成滑阻等均实现在线100%自动化检测。通过为每件产品激光烧刻唯一编码，可实现对产品制程关键数据（如螺钉力矩、转角等）的精确追溯。目前，伯特利全球各生产基地基础卡钳年产能近900万件，EPB卡钳年产能近1400万件，在中国品牌供应商中持续保持第一。

规模化量产的同时，伯特利EPB的市场版图也在向海外延伸。从奇瑞、吉利、广汽、北汽、长安、东风等本土主流车企，到福特、大众、丰田、沃尔沃、Stellantis等国际汽车品牌。今年4月，伯特利在北美市场再获项目，前制动卡钳及后EPB卡钳项目全生命周期供货规模达233.5万台车，创下单一项目供货规模之最。近期，伯特利再获两项欧洲市场项目定点，国际化布局不断深入。

面向欧洲、北美等重点市场，公司已在美国底特律、德国法兰克福设立海外研发中心，并推进摩洛哥生产基地建设，持续完善海外研发与制造布局。

4000万件，是一个产品十余年量产积累的阶段性成果，也记录着伯特利EPB从技术突破走向规模应用、从中国市场走向全球市场的发展历程。站在新的起点上，伯特利将继续依托在制动领域的技术积累与规模化量产经验，推动EPB及相关产品持续升级，以更加成熟、可靠的产品与解决方案服务全球客户。

queue.title: 技术突破获权威认可！伯特利EMB斩获2026国际新能源汽车创新技...
queue.text:
近日，第八届世界新能源汽车大会（WNEVC 2026）举办期间，备受行业瞩目的国际新能源汽车创新技术评选结果正式揭晓。 伯特利联合理想汽车开发的EMB电控机械制动 成功获评“2026国际新能源汽车创新技术”，成为本届11项获评技术之一，评选结果由中国工程院院士孙逢春在大会期间正式发布。

世界新能源汽车大会由中国科学技术协会、科学技术部、工业和信息化部、海南省政府联合主办。本届创新技术评选由中国汽车工程学会牵头组织，终评委员会由近十位两院院士组成，经国内外权威专家多轮评审，最终从全球59项候选技术中评选出11项入选技术。

伯特利联合理想汽车开发的EMB，是双方面向下一代智能底盘的重要技术成果。区别于传统液压制动系统，EMB以电子信号直接控制制动执行机构，取消制动液及液压管路，实现制动系统从液压控制向电子控制的架构升级。自EMB正式立项，双方即组建深度绑定的联合开发团队，攻克多项软硬件开发难题。历经三轮完整产品设计迭代、三轮夏冬季标定，建立起覆盖硬件结构、软件系统、测试验证等环节的技术体系，并获得全球首张由TÜV NORD颁发的ISO 26262 ASIL-D最高等级功能安全认证。

目前，伯特利EMB搭载于理想L9 Livis车型已实现量产交付，并收获市场广泛好评。与此同时， 伯特利已与多家车企达成EMB量产项目定点，覆盖混合动力SUV、纯电SUV及纯电轿车等车型平台， 持续推动EMB从前沿技术逐步走向规模化应用。

此次获评“2026国际新能源汽车创新技术”，是业界对伯特利与理想汽车联合技术创新及量产落地成果的认可。未来，伯特利将持续深耕智能底盘核心技术，推进EMB等前沿技术的研发与产业化应用，深化与整车企业及产业链伙伴的协同创新，加速技术成果向规模化量产转化，为全球汽车智能化发展提供更加安全、高效的底盘技术支撑。

queue.title: Continental Develops Concept Tire Containing Over 40 Percent Recycled Materials for EU Project
queue.text:
EU-funded ZEvRA project highlights potential of circular value chains for electric cars

ZEvRA stands for “Zero Emission Electric Vehicles Enabled by Harmonized Circularity”

Continental only tire manufacturer among project’s 28 partners

“Circular materials can help save resources and energy while reducing greenhouse gas emissions. They are key to making mobility more sustainable,” says Dr. Andreas Topp, head of Platform Development and Industrialization for passenger-car tires at Continental

Hanover, Germany, August 25, 2026. As part of the EU-funded ZEvRA project, Continental has developed a concept tire made from around 43 percent recycled materials. The concept tire highlights the potential of innovative material approaches. It also demonstrates the need for a reliable framework when adopting recycling technologies on an industrial scale.

“Circular materials can help save resources and energy while reducing greenhouse gas emissions. They are key to making mobility more sustainable,” says Dr. Andreas Topp, head of Platform Development and Industrialization for passenger-car tires at Continental. “We have extensive experience in developing high-performance materials from renewable and recycled sources. Our concept tire shows what is technically possible today – while serving as a catalyst for the innovations of tomorrow,” he adds.

The project name ZEvRA stands for “Zero Emission Electric Vehicles Enabled by Harmonized Circularity.” The two-year EU project that will conclude in 2026 is aimed at optimizing the circular economy of electric vehicles along the entire value chain. Continental is the only tire manufacturer in the consortium.

Tires consist of numerous high-performance raw materials which are precisely balanced to ensure safety, efficiency and longevity. These complex technical requirements make circularity particularly challenging. Incorporating a high percentage of recycled materials into a safety-critical product while still meeting high performance standards therefore constitutes a significant step forward. The concept tire demonstrates the compatibility of sustainability and performance, achieving the highest rating for the EU rolling resistance label.

Mission accomplished: concept tire made from high share of physically recycled materials

The ZEvRA concept tire consists of around 43 percent recycled materials, including recycled tall oil, steel, rubber from end-of-life tires and polyester fibers made from recycled PET bottles. Continental also leverages technologies such as pyrolysis, which involves extracting materials like recovered carbon black (rCB) from end-of-life tires so they can be repurposed for another use. Since 2023, recovered carbon black has been employed at the Korbach site in all newly produced solid rubber tires. The tires are fitted primarily on forklift trucks. In addition, sand – which forms as a residue in foundries, for example (rSand) – is used in a recycling process to manufacture an alternative silica variant. Recycling keeps materials in circulation and replaces the need for primary raw materials.

The new concept tire highlights the potential of highly circular tire production. The insights gained from this will form the basis for further development of related materials and technologies at Continental, with a particular focus on industrial availability and processing of suitable recycling materials as well as scaling of manufacturing processes. The aim is to further increase the share of recycled materials used in future tire generations.

Clear regulatory frameworks are essential

Recovered carbon black is one example of a recycling solution that is already in effective use today. At the same time, there are many processes still in industrialization. “The ZEvRA project shows that technological progress can only achieve its full impact when reliable, aligned frameworks provide planning certainty and support the market ramp-up of new processes,” Topp explains. This requires standard European-wide definitions for recycled materials, as well as clearly defined criteria stipulating when processed substances are classified as recycled raw materials. Technological openness and ongoing development of recycling technologies and associated infrastructures are just as important if high-quality recycled raw materials are to be made available in sufficient quantities. Resilient supply chains and internationally coordinated procedures for material flow allocation are also crucial for the widespread use of recycled materials.

“The next step is to establish innovative recycling technologies on an industrial scale and set up closed material flows. This is essential to accelerate the transformation to a resource- and climate-friendly circular economy,” explains Jorge Almeida, head of Sustainability for Continental’s Tires group sector. “A standardized approach to calculation and reporting should be developed through close dialogue between policymakers and stakeholders. If implemented through regulation, it must be simple, transparent and easy for consumers to understand in order to promote genuine progress rather than create unnecessary bureaucracy,” he adds. In addition to recycled materials, renewable raw materials also play an important role. The share of renewable raw materials in the concept tire is around 13 percent. A further 25 percent consists of mass-balance-certified materials. Together with the roughly 43 percent share of recycled materials, more than 80 percent of the materials used in the ZEvRA concept tire come from recycled, renewable or mass-balance-certified sources.

Continental is continually increasing the share of recycled and renewable materials. Since 2022, polyester casings made from recycled PET bottles have been used in selected passenger-car tires. queue.title: Fitted with Continental Tires: New Volkswagen ID. Polo
queue.text:
Volkswagen grants Continental original-equipment approval for ID. Polo

Efficient EcoContact 7 summer tire in 17- and 18-inch sizes

WinterContact TS 870 P and AllSeasonContact 2 for year-round safety

Hanover, Germany, August 26, 2026. Continental has received original-equipment approval for the new Volkswagen ID. Polo. The all-electric compact model will be fitted as standard with Continental’s EcoContact 7 summer tire, after the Wolfsburg-based car manufacturer approved the 17- and 18-inch sizes. Volkswagen also recommends the 18-inch versions of the AllSeasonContact 2 and the WinterContact TS 870 P.

The EcoContact 7 is an efficient summer tire designed for low rolling resistance and high mileage. A special combination of materials in the tire’s construction reduces internal friction, thereby lowering rolling resistance. This reduces the vehicle’s energy consumption and improves efficiency. Another feature is the Aerodimple structure in the tire sidewall. Inspired by the dimples on a golf ball, these recesses reduce air turbulence behind the tires, reducing the energy required to move the vehicle. The Silent Pattern tread design helps minimize rolling noise: the optimized spacing and angles of the tread blocks are tuned to the noise frequencies typically generated when driving in urban areas.

The right tire for every weather condition

For winter driving, Volkswagen recommends the WinterContact TS 870 P. Its tread design and innovative sipe structure provide reliable grip on snow and ice. The rubber compound remains flexible even at low temperatures, enabling short braking distances and safe handling in wet, cold and snowy conditions.

Drivers who prefer to use a single set of tires all year round can choose the AllSeasonContact 2. Continental's all-season tire offers balanced performance in both summer and wet winter conditions.

These tire lines have been approved and are recommended for the new Volkswagen ID. Polo in the following sizes in numerous countries worldwide:

EcoContact 7, 215/55 R17 94T FR EcoContact 7, 215/50 R18 92T FR AllSeasonContact 2, 215/50 R18 96T XL WinterContact TS 870 P, 215/50 R18 96T XL

Based on our customers’ specific requirements, we design our tires for the relevant vehicle model. Our special area of expertise: fine-tuning a particular aspect of driving behavior.

Spokeswoman, Technology and Sustainability

queue.title: Ready for Every Season: New Audi Q3 Fitted with Continental Tires
queue.text:
Continental receives original-equipment approval for summer tire; recommendations for winter and all-season tires

EcoContact 6 Q, ProContact TX10 and WinterContact TS 870 P cover all driving conditions

Approvals for sizes from 17 to 20 inches

Hanover, Germany, September 8, 2026. Continental supplies factory-fitted tires for the new Audi Q3, providing year-round performance in summer heat, autumn rain and winter snow. For its compact SUV model, Audi has granted original-equipment approvals for the EcoContact 6 Q summer tire. The car manufacturer also recommends the ProContact TX10 all-season tire and the WinterContact TS 870 P winter tire. The approvals cover tire sizes from 17 to 20 inches.

The EcoContact 6 Q is a summer tire designed for particularly low rolling resistance and high energy efficiency. A specially developed rubber compound and an optimized tread pattern reduce rolling resistance, helping to lower fuel consumption. At the same time, the tire impresses with low rolling noise and short braking distances on both wet and dry surfaces. The EcoContact 6 Q is approved for the Audi Q3 in 18-, 19- and 20-inch sizes.

The ProContact TX10 is a reliable all-season tire for drivers who want one tire for all seasons. It is designed to provide balanced traction in all weather conditions, offering reliable braking performance on wet roads, low rolling noise and good grip in light snow. The ProContact TX10 is approved for the US and Canadian market and is available in 18-, 19- and 20-inch sizes.

Safe through winter with Continental’s WinterContact TS 870 P

For demanding winter conditions, Audi recommends Continental’s WinterContact TS 870 P winter tire. Thanks to its newly developed tread design and innovative sipes, it provides reliable grip on snow and ice. Its rubber compound remains flexible even at low temperatures, enabling short braking distances and confident handling in cold, wet and snowy conditions. The WinterContact TS 870 P is approved for the Audi Q3 in 17- and 19-inch sizes.

queue.title: ContiMotion EVO: Continental Unveils New Sport Touring Tire as the Successor to the ContiMotion
queue.text:
Continental’s EasyHandling technology delivers enhanced handling and greater agility

Hybrid tread compound improves wet grip without compromising mileage

Hanover, Germany, September 10, 2026. With the ContiMotion EVO, Continental is launching the successor to its popular ContiMotion sport touring tire. The new tire combines several product improvements and is aimed at riders who value a balanced combination of riding pleasure, safety and mileage.

“With the ContiMotion EVO, we’re offering a versatile sport touring tire,” said Christoph Ettenhuber, Head of Business Field Motorcycle Tires at Continental. “It combines intuitive handling with reliable grip in both wet and dry conditions – all while delivering impressive mileage for everyday use.”

Compared to its predecessor, the ContiMotion EVO offers several technical improvements. New carcass materials provide additional stability and consistency, resulting in enhanced handling and more agile riding dynamics. This is complemented by updated compounds to improve wet and dry performance.

The ContiMotion EVO stands out thanks to four key features:

Intuitive handling and great agility for a fun riding experience. Continental’s EasyHandling technology and an optimized tire construction deliver predictable steering response.

Strong confidence through reliable grip in both dry and wet conditions – thanks to an optimized hybrid silica tread compound.

High mileage and long-lasting performance thanks to its advanced compound and dedicated pattern.

High-speed stability , enabled by the ZeroDegree steel-belt construction and new carcass materials.

“The ContiMotion EVO has been upgraded in key areas without losing the fundamental renowned qualities of its predecessor,” explained Christoph Ettenhuber. “Riders benefit from a tire that is noticeably more agile.”

The ContiMotion EVO is designed for both sporty weekend riders as well as touring enthusiasts. Motorcycles that can be equipped with the ContiMotion EVO include, among others, the BMW R12 nineT, the Triumph Daytona 660, the Ducati Supersport 950, the Honda CB 650R, the Suzuki GSX-8TT and the Yamaha MT-09.

“The ContiMotion EVO is compatible with a wide range of popular naked bikes, roadsters and modern classics,” said Christoph Ettenhuber, Head of Business Field Motorcycle Tires at Continental.

Available sizes starting in September 2026

ContiMotion EVO and ContiMotion can be combined with each other.

Press spokeswoman Motorcycle Tires Continental Tires

queue.title: Safe Through Ice and Snow: Continental Expands Conti Scandinavia Winter Tire Portfolio
queue.text:
New 315/60 R 22.5 steering axle tire broadens the range for winter operations

Winter tire technology combines traction, mileage and year-round usability

Retread solutions complement the tire lifecycle

Hanover, Germany, September 15, 2026. Continental is expanding its Conti Scandinavia winter tire portfolio with a new 315/60 R 22.5 steering axle tire. Developed for demanding winter road conditions, the Conti Scandinavia range is designed to deliver reliable traction on snow, ice and wet roads while maintaining high mileage and efficient rolling performance. To support long-term tire management, the portfolio is complemented by Continental's retread solutions.

Tire Technology Designed for Winter Performance

The Conti Scandinavia tire family has been developed specifically for challenging winter conditions and includes solutions for different axle positions. Optimized tread patterns and winter compounds are engineered to provide traction and handling on snow-covered, icy and wet roads while supporting the durability required for regional and long-haul transport applications. A key feature of the portfolio is Continental's two-layer sipe technology. Designed to support traction, driving stability and handling throughout the tire's service life, the technology helps maintain winter performance while also contributing to mileage and rolling efficiency.

The specially developed tread compounds remain flexible at low temperatures, supporting grip in winter conditions without compromising operational performance. Low noise levels and year-round applicability further enhance the versatility of the range. “Winter tires must deliver reliable traction and handling in challenging road conditions without compromising mileage and operational efficiency. The Conti Scandinavia portfolio has been developed to meet exactly these requirements, while the new 315/60 R 22.5 steering axle tire further expands the range for our customers,” says Hinnerk Kaiser, Head of Bus and Truck Tire Development at Continental.

With the introduction of the new 315/60 R 22.5 steering axle tire, Continental is further strengthening its winter offering for commercial vehicles. The additional dimension expands the application range of the Conti Scandinavia portfolio and provides customers with greater flexibility when selecting tire configurations for specific operational requirements.

Retreads Complement Tire Lifecycle Management

In addition to new tires, Continental offers retread solutions that help extend casing utilization as part of a comprehensive tire management approach. By combining premium new tires with retreading, fleet operators can maximize the use of tire assets over a longer period while maintaining the performance requirements of commercial transport operations. Further information on Continental's winter tire portfolio is available in the Winter Brochure.

queue.title: Continental Expands Portfolio of Large and High-Performance Tires
queue.text:
More than 650 new ultra-high-performance (UHP) tire sizes to be added by the end of 2027

In 2025, UHP tires accounted for 62 percent of Continental brand passenger-car tire sales (2020: 49 percent)

Core product, the SportContact 7, has ranked among the top three in 27 of 29 international tire tests since its launch and demonstrates Continental’s UHP expertise

Edwin Goudswaard, head of Research and Development for Continental’s Tires group sector: “As modern vehicles become larger, heavier and more powerful, tires are becoming even more critical. They are no longer simply the vehicle’s connection to the road, but a key prerequisite for safety, efficiency and driving dynamics.”

Hanover, Germany, September 16, 2026. Continental has significantly expanded its global portfolio of ultra-high-performance (UHP) tires – tires measuring 18 inches and above – over the past five years and plans to strengthen this segment further in the future. By the end of 2027, the company will add more than 650 new tire sizes across all tire lines, for both original equipment on new cars and the replacement market. By expanding its portfolio, the tire manufacturer is responding to growing demand for high-performance tires designed for larger, heavier and more powerful vehicles, as well as electrified drive systems, while laying the foundation for further profitable growth in this segment.

“With our expanded UHP portfolio, we are responding directly to the increasing demands of modern vehicles,” says Edwin Goudswaard, head of Research and Development for Continental’s Tires group sector. “This enables us to offer our customers around the world even more tailored solutions for safety, efficiency and driving dynamics.”

Growing importance of high-performance tires

High-performance tires for passenger cars and light commercial vehicles have become increasingly important for Continental and its customers in recent years. Between 2020 and 2025, their share of sales in the global business for passenger-car tires across all brands rose from 41 percent to 55 percent. The proportion is particularly high in the Asia-Pacific region (70 percent) and the Americas (66 percent), while in the EMEA region UHP tires account for 43 percent of passenger-car tire sales. For the Continental brand, the share of UHP tires in global passenger-car tire sales increased from around 49 percent in 2020 to around 62 percent in 2025. This highlights the growing importance of high-performance tires for modern vehicles and the strategic relevance of this segment for Continental.

The trend toward ever-larger tires is closely linked to developments in the vehicle market. Vehicles are becoming not only larger, but also heavier and more powerful. SUVs in particular have been growing in popularity for many years and are now an increasingly common sight on the roads. Another key driver of rising vehicle weight is electric mobility: the batteries used in electric vehicles add considerably to their overall mass. At the same time, modern drive systems generate levels of torque once associated only with high-performance sports cars.

This, in turn, is placing greater demands on modern tires, which must be able to support heavier loads while continuing to ensure safety, efficiency and driving comfort. Ultra-high-performance tires in particular combine high grip, short braking distances and precise handling with low rolling resistance and high mileage. Continental develops these tires primarily for large wheel-and-tire combinations of 18 inches and above, as well as for performance SUVs, premium sedans, sports cars and high-performance electric vehicles.

“As modern tires become larger, heavier and more powerful, tires are becoming even more critical. They are no longer simply the vehicle’s connection to the road, but a key prerequisite for safety, efficiency and driving dynamics,” says Goudswaard. “The UHP segment clearly demonstrates how capable modern tires need to be. The art lies in combining conflicting requirements at the highest level, and that is precisely what sets our tires apart.”

More than 650 new tire sizes for key global regions

Continental is expanding its UHP offering across all major markets and will introduce more than 650 new tire sizes for original equipment and the replacement business by the end of 2027. In addition to the core Continental brand, this includes secondary brands such as Semperit and Uniroyal. The growing number of tire sizes also reflects the increasing diversification of the vehicle market. Manufacturers are offering their models in more and more variants worldwide and require tires that are precisely tailored to different performance, efficiency and comfort requirements.

Material expertise and intensive testing for maximum performance

Ultra-high-performance tires must meet a wide range of requirements, some of which are conflicting. They must provide high grip on dry and wet roads, short braking distances and precise handling, while at the same time delivering low rolling resistance, high ride comfort and high mileage. The rubber compound plays a central role in achieving this balance, as it largely determines a tire’s performance profile and must balance multiple characteristics.

To meet these requirements, Continental relies on extensive development and testing procedures. These range from digital simulations and laboratory analyses to bench tests and comprehensive driving tests under a wide variety of temperatures, loads, speeds and road conditions. The High Performance Technology Center in Korbach is a key innovation hub for the advancement of manufacturing processes for high-performance tires. Insights gained there are applied throughout Continental’s global production network, where UHP tires up to 24 inches in size are manufactured. Their performance is then tested under real-world conditions at test tracks including the Contidrom near Hanover, as well as facilities in Arvidsjaur, Sweden, and Uvalde,

queue.title: Continental Completes Conti Eco Generation 5 Portfolio with New Trailer Tire
queue.text:
New Conti Eco HT 5 completes Continental's Conti Eco Generation 5 portfolio for steer, drive and trailer axles

Trailer tire designed to support fuel efficiency through lower rolling resistance

High mileage, even wear and reliable performance across varying operating conditions

Coordinated tire solution helps fleets reduce operating costs across the truck and trailer combination

Hanover, Germany, September 22, 2026. Continental is introducing the new Conti Eco HT 5 trailer tire, completing its fifth-generation Conti Eco portfolio for freight transport. Together with the Conti Eco HS 5 steer tire and Conti Eco HD 5 drive tire, it provides fleets with a coordinated solution that combines lower operating costs, high mileage and reduced rolling resistance that can help improve fuel efficiency. Developed for regional and long-distance transport operations, the Conti Eco HT 5 extends the benefits of the Conti Eco Generation 5 family to the trailer axle. While trailer tires are not driven, they account for a significant share of the rolling resistance of a truck and trailer combination. Lower rolling resistance at the trailer axle can help reduce fuel consumption and consequently, vehicle-related CO₂ emissions during operation. “Every tire contributes to the efficiency and operating costs of a truck and trailer combination. While attention often focuses on the steer and drive axles, trailer tires also play an important role in rolling resistance and fuel consumption,” says Hinnerk Kaiser, responsible for the development of truck and bus tires in the EMEA region at Continental. “With the Conti Eco HT 5, we are extending the benefits of our fifth-generation Conti Eco portfolio to the trailer axle and helping fleets improve the efficiency of their transport operations.”

A trailer typically runs on multiple tires that are continuously in contact with the road. As a result, trailer tires have a direct impact on stability, fuel efficiency and overall operating performance. Depending on vehicle configuration, trailer tires can account for up to 50 percent of the total rolling resistance of a truck and trailer combination*. The new Conti Eco HT 5 has been engineered to deliver a good balance of low rolling resistance and high mileage, while promoting even wear and providing reliable grip across a wide range of operating conditions. The tire incorporates rolling-resistance-optimized materials, a newly designed sidewall and advanced filler compounds to improve fuel efficiency.

An innovative tread compound and refined curing process contribute to high mileage and long service life, while a redesigned five-rib tread pattern promotes even wear, stable handling and consistent performance in varying weather and road conditions on both regional and long-haul routes. Compared with the Conti Hybrid HT3+, the new Conti Eco HT 5 delivers up to a 12 percent reduction in rolling resistance under specified test conditions**. These improvements can help fleets reduce fuel consumption, lower CO₂ emissions and decrease tire-related operating costs. “For the Conti Eco HT 5, our focus was on improving efficiency while maintaining durability,” explains Kaiser. “The combination of low rolling resistance, long service life and balanced wear characteristics can help fleets reduce tire-related operating costs while maintaining reliable performance in demanding transport operations.”

The Conti Eco Generation 5 portfolio forms part of Continental's broader effort to support customers in improving transport efficiency through technological innovation and optimized tire performance. By combining low rolling resistance, high mileage and long service life across all axle positions, the portfolio supports customers in addressing key industry challenges, including rising fuel costs, increasing regulatory and customer requirements related to transport efficiency and emissions reduction.

A Complete Solution for Freight Transport

The fifth-generation Conti Eco portfolio brings together steer, drive and trailer axle tires in a coordinated solution for freight transport. Combining low rolling resistance, high mileage and long service life, it helps fleet operators improve efficiency across the entire vehicle combination while supporting lower operating costs and reliable performance.

The Conti Eco HT 5 will be available starting September 2026 in the following sizes: 385/65 R 22.5 and 385/55 R 22.5.

* 2-Axle Tractor and 3-Axle Trailer combination fully loaded. ** Compared with the Conti Hybrid HT3+ predecessor product under specified test conditions. Test methodology, reference product and test conditions available on request.

queue.title: Continental Sells mycar Tyre & Auto to Tuhu
queue.text:
Continental sells one of Australia’s largest tyre, automotive service and repair chains to Chinese automotive service platform Tuhu, subject to regulatory approvals

Through its own distribution network Continental has a strong market presence in Australia and will continue to work with mycar Tyre & Auto as a distribution partner

Dalibor Kalina, head of the tyre business in the Asia-Pacific region: “mycar Tyre & Auto has developed very successfully under the Continental umbrella and is now exceptionally well positioned in the Australian market”

Min Chen, founder and CEO of Tuhu: “Australia is a highly attractive and promising market for automotive services, we look forward to building on mycar Tyre & Auto’s strong foundation and bringing Tuhu’s capabilities and experience to the Australian market”

Sydney, September 24, 2026. Continental has announced the sale of its subsidiary mycar Tyre & Auto, one of the largest tyre, automotive service and repair chains in Australia, to Tuhu, a leading Chinese automotive service platform. The transaction is based on an enterprise value of 403 million Australian dollars (approx. 250 million euros). The transaction marks another step in Continental’s strategic focus on its core business to develop and manufacture tyres. Under Tuhu’s ownership, mycar Tyre & Auto will have an owner with a strong focus on automotive services, providing a solid platform for the business to continue its growth and realise its potential. All of the more than 1,600 employees and around 280 stores of mycar Tyre & Auto are part of the transaction, which is subject to regulatory approvals.

“mycar Tyre & Auto has developed very successfully under the Continental umbrella and is now exceptionally well positioned in the Australian market,” said Dalibor Kalina, head of Continental’s tyre business in the Asia-Pacific region. “In Tuhu, mycar Tyre & Auto is gaining an owner with many years of experience who will actively drive the company’s strategic direction and sustainable long-term development. Tuhu and Continental have a long-standing and strong strategic partnership in China. With our own sales organisation in Australia and the continued distribution of our tyres through the mycar Tyre & Auto network, we will ensure seamless continuity for our customers,” Kalina added.

“Australia is a highly attractive and promising market for automotive services, and mycar Tyre & Auto is a distinctive business with a strong position in this market,” said Min Chen, founder and CEO of Tuhu. “We look forward to working closely with the existing management team and employees, while continuing our long-standing partnership with Continental. As a new entrant to the Australian market from China, we are committed to adapting quickly to the local market and building on mycar’s strong foundation established under Continental’s management and its proven track record of responsible and reliable operations. By bringing Tuhu’s capabilities and experience to Australia, we look forward to continuing to deliver value, choice and convenience for Australian vehicle owners,” he added.

Successful expansion of distribution in Australia

Continental acquired mycar Tyre & Auto in 2018 to expand its distribution network in Australia and strengthen its global presence in the tyre market. Since the acquisition, Australia has developed into an established and important market for the company. At the same time, Continental has built its own strong and highly capable sales organisation in Australia over recent years.

Under Continental’s ownership, mycar Tyre & Auto has steadily strengthened its market position in Australia over the past eight years through an expanded store network, a broader product portfolio and an enhanced market presence. The partnership between Continental and Tuhu creates opportunities for closer cooperation in the future. Following the completion of the transaction, mycar Tyre & Auto will remain a distribution partner of Continental in Australia and will continue to sell Continental tires there.

With around 280 stores across Australia, mycar Tyre & Auto offers a comprehensive range of automotive services, including scheduled maintenance, tyres, brakes, suspension, batteries and general mechanical repairs. The company has more than 1,600 employees in Australia, making mycar one of the largest employers in the automotive service and repair industry.

Tuhu is a leading automotive service platform in China and operates the world's largest automotive service network by the store number under management, while serving the largest user base among automotive service platforms in China. As of June 30, 2026, Tuhu's service network comprised 8,825 Tuhu Workshops, and it had approximately 31 million transacting users during the twelve months ending June 30, 2026. Through its integrated online and offline model, Tuhu addresses a broad range of automotive service needs, including tyre and chassis-component replacement, vehicle maintenance and repair, detailing and other related services.

queue.title: Porsche Chooses Continental Tires
queue.text:
Porsche Panamera G3 II fitted with SportContact 7 and new SportContact 7 Force

For wintry conditions, Porsche recommends WinterContact TS 860 S for Porsche Cayenne E4

Hanover, Germany, September 29, 2026. Continental has received two new approvals to supply original-equipment tires for Porsche models. The automotive manufacturer has approved both the SportContact 7 and the new SportContact 7 Force for the Panamera G3 II. The SportContact 7 Force is a high-performance addition to Continental’s summer tire line. Porsche also recommends the WinterContact TS 860 S for the Cayenne E4 during the colder months. All tires are approved in 21- and 22-inch sizes, with XL markings, indicating increased load capacity.

The SportContact 7 is a summer tire designed for exceptionally responsive, precise handling. Its rubber compound and tread pattern are optimized for excellent grip and short braking distances on both dry and wet roads, providing exceptional driving stability, even at high speeds.

Also approved for the Panamera G3 II is the new SportContact 7 Force, a specially developed version of the SportContact 7 designed to meet even higher demands in terms of performance and stability. Its adaptive tread pattern and enhanced rubber compound enable more precise handling and high levels of power transfer under extreme conditions. The tire combines track-proven performance with everyday usability.

Cayenne E4 equipped with Continental winter tires

For the Cayenne E4, Porsche recommends the WinterContact TS 860 S for the colder months. This winter specialist has been specifically designed to meet the requirements of high-powered, handling-focused SUVs. It delivers short braking distances and precise handling on dry roads, along with strong performance in snow, providing a high degree of control and stability. In addition, its low rolling resistance can help increase the range of electric vehicles.

These tire lines have been approved for the above mentioned Porsche models in the following sizes in numerous countries:

Panamera G3 II : SportContact 7, 275/35 ZR 21 FR 103Y XL Panamera G3 II : SportContact 7, 325/30 ZR 21 FR 108Y XL Panamera G3 II : SportContact 7 Force, 275/35 ZR 21 FR 103Y XL Panamera G3 II : SportContact 7 Force, 325/30 ZR 21 FR 108Y XL Cayenne E4 : WinterContact TS 860 S, 275/40 R22 107V XL FR Cayenne E4 : WinterContact TS 860 S, 315/35 R22 111V XL FR

Based on our customers’ specific requirements, we design our tires for the relevant vehicle model. Our special area of expertise: fine-tuning a particular aspect of driving behavior.
